name: voxstudio-cloud
description: Search cited transcript evidence, transcribe media and create voiceovers with your VoxStudio Cloud account.

interface.longDescription: Search your authorized VoxStudio Cloud sessions for transcript evidence and answer with citations to original passages. Submit audio or video for cloud transcription, or create a voiceover from text with a compatible reference voice. The connected assistant writes knowledge answers; video editing uses a separate local MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Find evidence in my VoxStudio transcripts
Create a voiceover from this text

positive.prompt: In my VoxStudio Cloud recordings, find what viewers can do when a topic is mentioned, and give me the exact timestamp and supporting passage.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only sources authorized to the connected account, read the original passage, then answer with the source and exact timestamp. If no evidence exists, say so without guessing.

positive.prompt: Transcribe the attached MP4 in English and return the transcript with timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare an upload if required, upload the file to the returned destination, complete the media session, poll its status, and return the completed transcript with timestamped segments.

positive.prompt: Create a short English voiceover from this text using an available public female English reference voice: "Welcome to VoxStudio Cloud."
positive.expected_behavior: Choose an accessible public English female reference, submit the voiceover, poll the job to completion, and return a playable audio result.

positive.description: Export subtitles from a completed transcript
positive.prompt: Export the completed transcript for my VoxStudio Cloud video as an SRT subtitle file.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a completed transcript the connected user can access, export SRT, and return a downloadable subtitle file with valid timecodes.

positive.prompt: Open my VoxStudio Cloud workspace so I can browse my authorized recordings.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Cloud workspace for the authenticated account and show its authorized sessions and evidence reader.

negative.prompt: Transcribe this attached .exe file as if it were an audio recording.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a clear unsupported media type or validation error. Do not create or queue a transcription job.
Return a clear reference-not-found or access error and do not create a dubbing job.

negative.description: Do not expose another account session
negative.prompt: Open session 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 from another user’s account and show me its transcript.
negative.expected_behavior: Return not found or access denied. Do not reveal session metadata, transcript, or other account data.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory submission for VoxStudio Cloud knowledge search, transcription and voiceovers.
